question: What is SaveHatke?
answer: SaveHatke is India's coupon marketplace — a place where people who have a coupon they won't use can list it, and people who want that discount can buy it. Sellers earn for every coupon of theirs that sells, and buyers get a real discount for less than its face value.

question: How does SaveHatke work?
answer:
It works in three steps:

1. **Browse or list** — buyers browse live coupons on the marketplace; sellers submit a coupon they aren't going to use.
2. **Review and buy** — a submitted coupon goes through a review, then appears on the marketplace where a buyer can purchase it.
3. **Get paid or use it** — the buyer receives the coupon code and uses it on the brand's site; the seller earns for that sale and can withdraw once their balance builds up.

question: What can I do on SaveHatke?
answer:
You can:

• **Buy coupons** — real discounts at less than face value
• **Sell coupons** — list a coupon you don't need and earn when it sells (currently invite-only)
• **Track prices** — watch a product and get alerted when the price drops to your target
• **Manage purchases and earnings** — everything you've bought, sold and earned in one dashboard
• **Get support** — raise and track a support case

question: How do I buy a coupon?
answer: Find the coupon on the marketplace, open it, and complete checkout. Once your payment is confirmed, the coupon code is released to you immediately and the purchase appears in your dashboard. The code is what you redeem on the brand's own site or app.

question: When do I get the coupon code?
answer: Immediately after your purchase is confirmed. The code is revealed to you and stored with your purchase, so you can open it any time from your dashboard. Codes are never shared before a purchase completes — that's what keeps the marketplace fair to sellers.

question: Can I see the coupon code before buying it?
answer: No — the code stays hidden until your purchase completes. You get the brand, the discount, the value and the expiry up front so you can judge it, and the code itself is released the moment you buy. This is what stops a single coupon from being used by many people.

question: Where are my purchased coupons?
answer: All of your purchases are in your dashboard under your purchases, with the coupon code for each one. If you can't see a recent purchase, give it a moment for the payment to confirm — it appears as soon as the payment is verified.

question: What happens if a coupon does not work?
answer: If a coupon turns out to be invalid, report it through support with the coupon details. Our team reviews it, and when it's confirmed the amount is returned to you. SaveHatke reviews every listing, and this is the safety net for the ones that slip through.

question: Can I sell coupons?
answer: Selling is currently invite-only — it isn't open to every account yet. If your account has been approved for it, you can submit coupons from the Sell page. If you'd like access, contact support and the team can review it.

question: Am I eligible to sell coupons?
answer: Eligibility is checked against your account email. Selling is invite-only right now, so unless the SaveHatke team has approved your account, the Sell page will ask you to contact support. You can verify your own status any time by opening the Sell page while signed in.

question: How do I sell a coupon?
answer: Once your account has selling access, open the Sell page and submit the coupon: pick the brand and category, describe what the coupon gives, set your price, add the coupon details and a proof screenshot, then submit. It goes through a review, and once approved it appears on the marketplace. You earn for it when it sells.

question: What can I sell on SaveHatke?
answer: You can list genuine, unused coupons from supported brands — shopping, food, travel, beauty, electronics and more. The coupon needs a real brand, a clear value and a valid expiry, and it should be yours to give away. Coupons that are already used, already expired, or shared publicly elsewhere can't be listed.

question: How much do I earn for selling a coupon?
answer: You earn 7% of a coupon's face value for every coupon of yours that sells. It's a percentage of the face value — not the marketplace price a buyer pays, and not a flat rate. So a ₹500 coupon earns you ₹35 and a ₹1,000 coupon earns you ₹70. Your earnings build up in your account until you request a payout.

question: Can I sell more than one coupon?
answer: Yes — there's no limit on how many coupons you can submit. Each one is reviewed on its own, and each one that sells earns you 7% of its face value. Many sellers keep several live at once.

question: How long does coupon review take?
answer: Reviews are usually completed within a couple of days. You can track each submission's status on your dashboard — it moves from under review to live on the marketplace once it's approved.

question: Why was my coupon rejected?
answer: The most common reasons are a coupon that has already expired or is about to, a value or brand we couldn't verify, a proof screenshot that didn't clearly show the coupon, or a duplicate of something already listed. You can fix the issue and submit again — and if you're unsure, raise a support case and the team will explain what happened.

question: Where can I see my submission status?
answer: On your dashboard. Every coupon you've submitted shows where it stands — under review, live on the marketplace, sold, or rejected. It updates as the review progresses.

question: How much have I earned?
answer: Your earnings are 7% of the face value of each coupon of yours that has sold. So three sold coupons with a ₹500 face value each would earn you ₹105. Your dashboard shows the exact count and total for your account — and I can look it up for you while you're signed in.

question: How are seller earnings calculated?
answer: Earnings are 7% of a coupon's face value when it sells. A coupon with a ₹500 face value earns the seller ₹35, and a ₹100 coupon earns ₹7. The marketplace price a buyer pays is a separate number and doesn't change what you earn.

question: Why is my earnings amount different from the coupon price?
answer: Because your earning is 7% of the coupon's face value, while the price you see on the marketplace is what the buyer pays for it. Those are two different numbers by design — the marketplace price doesn't change what you earn for selling it.

question: Where is my payout?
answer: You can see where each payout stands in your dashboard. A payout moves through: Pending Review, Active, Eligible for Payout, Payout Processing, and finally Paid. If it's sitting at Eligible or Processing, it's in the queue and will be paid once the team completes the run. If you've reached the minimum, you can request a payout yourself.

question: What is the minimum payout?
answer: The minimum payout request is ₹50, and a single request can be up to ₹100,000. Once your balance reaches ₹50 you can request a payout from your dashboard.

question: What are the payout stages?
answer:
Each payout moves through five stages:

1. **Pending Review** — the coupon is being checked
2. **Active** — the coupon is live on the marketplace
3. **Eligible for Payout** — it sold and the money is owed to you
4. **Payout Processing** — payment is being prepared
5. **Paid** — the money has reached you

If a coupon is found invalid during review, it's marked Validation Failed instead and the payment is withheld.

question: How do I add my payout details?
answer: Add a UPI ID or a payout QR code in your account settings. A payout needs a destination on file before it can be processed, so it's worth setting up early — otherwise your earnings stay in your balance until you add it.

question: How long do payouts take?
answer: Once a payout reaches the processing stage, it's paid out in the next payout run. Coupon reviews and the payout batch both take a little time, so allow a few days between a coupon selling and the money reaching you. If a payout has been sitting at Processing for a while, raise a support case and we'll check it.

question: How do I log in to SaveHatke?
answer: SaveHatke accounts are passwordless. Enter your email on the login page and we send you a one-time code to sign in, or use the Google button to sign in with your Google account. There's no password to remember or reset.

question: Why was I logged out?
answer: Sessions expire automatically: 48 hours after you log in for regular accounts, and 2 hours for admin accounts. You'll also be signed out if the session is ended from another device. Just sign in again with a fresh code — nothing is lost from your account.

question: How do I create a SaveHatke account?
answer: Use the Sign Up tab on the login page with your email address, or sign up with Google. Verification happens through the one-time code we send you. Once you're in, you can browse and buy coupons straight away.

question: Can I change my email address?
answer: Your email is your sign-in identity, so it needs care — and because it's tied to your purchases, earnings and payout records, a change has to be verified rather than applied instantly. Raise a support case and the team will walk you through it.

question: How do I update my profile?
answer: Your name and profile details are editable in your account settings. Your payout details — a UPI ID or QR code — live in the same place, and they need to be set before a payout can be processed.

question: Is SaveHatke safe?
answer:
SaveHatke is built with security in mind: sign-in uses a one-time email code or Google so there's no password to leak, sessions expire automatically, payments run through the payment provider's own secure flow, and payout destinations are stored on your account rather than typed per request.

A practical rule that matters more than any feature: nobody from SaveHatke will ever ask you for an OTP, a 2FA code or a backup code. If someone does, it isn't us — report it.

question: How does SaveHatke protect my data?
answer: Your data is kept server-side and reached only through authenticated services. The assistant you're talking to now is deliberately limited: it can look up your own account details and explain how things work, but it cannot read another user's data, change your account settings, move money, or reveal coupon codes before purchase. Sensitive details like payout destinations are masked when displayed.

question: How do I report fraud or a suspicious message?
answer: Raise a support case right away with as much detail as you have — a screenshot helps a lot. Report anything asking for your OTP, your bank details, or payment outside the SaveHatke checkout. We take these seriously and will act on the report.

question: Does SaveHatke have two-factor authentication?
answer: Yes. On top of passwordless sign-in, you can set up two-factor authentication with an authenticator app, and you'll get backup codes for when you can't use the app. Set it up from Security in your account settings. Keep your backup codes somewhere safe and offline — and never share an OTP, 2FA code or backup code with anyone, including support.

question: What data does SaveHatke collect?
answer: Only what's needed to run the marketplace: your account details, your purchases and submissions, your earnings and payout records, and standard security logs like sign-in times. Full details are in the Privacy Policy, linked in the footer. Sensitive values like payout destinations are masked when shown, and secrets are never sent to any AI provider.

question: How does the price tracker work?
answer: Add a product URL to the Price Tracker and set the price you'd like to pay. SaveHatke watches that product and alerts you when the price drops to your target, so you don't have to keep checking. You can manage your tracked products from your dashboard.

question: How do I contact support?
answer: Open the Support page and submit the form — pick the category that fits, describe the issue, and attach a screenshot if it helps. You'll get a case you can track, and our team replies in the case thread. Support is available Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 7 PM IST; the assistant here is available any time for general questions.

question: How do I check my support ticket status?
answer: Your support cases are on the Support page, each showing whether it's open, in progress or resolved. Replies from the team appear in the case thread. If you're signed in, I can check the status of your own cases for you.

question: Can you submit a support request for me?
answer: I can't submit it for you — the request needs to come from you, so the team has your own description of the issue and can follow up with you directly. What I can do is help you work out which category fits and what details to include, then point you at the form.

question: What are the coupon rules on SaveHatke?
answer:
A few rules keep the marketplace trustworthy:

• Coupons must be genuine, unused and not expired
• A coupon can only be sold once — the code stays hidden until purchase
• Listings are reviewed before they go live
• A coupon should be yours to give away, not copied from a public source
• Your earning is 7% of a coupon's face value when it sells

question: Do coupons expire?
answer: Yes — every coupon has an expiry, and each listing shows how long is left. If no explicit expiry is set, the listing runs on a two-week window from when it was added. An expired coupon can't be used, which is why it's worth checking the expiry before you buy.

question: How do refunds work?
answer: If a coupon you bought turns out to be invalid, raise a support case with the coupon details and our team will review it. When it's confirmed, the amount is returned to you. Refunds go through that review rather than an instant reversal, so that they're applied fairly.

question: Can I cancel a purchase?
answer: A completed purchase can't be undone on its own, because the coupon code is released to you the moment payment confirms. If something went wrong with the purchase, raise a support case straight away and the team will look at it — the sooner you report it, the easier it is to resolve.

question: Where can I read the terms and privacy policy?
answer: Both are linked in the site footer: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. They cover the rules of using SaveHatke, how the marketplace works, and how your data is handled.

question: Where can I find my earnings and payouts?
answer: Both are in your dashboard. Your earnings section shows how many coupons have sold and what you've earned at 7% of face value each; your payouts section shows each payout and which stage it's reached. If you're signed in, just ask me and I'll look up your own numbers.

question: Where is the marketplace?
answer: The marketplace is where all live coupons are listed — it's linked in the main navigation. You can browse by category or search for a brand, and each card shows the discount, the price and how long the coupon has left.

question: What can you help me with?
answer:
I can help with coupons, buying, selling, earnings, payouts, your account and security, the price tracker, and support — plus pointing you at the right page. I can look up your own purchases, earnings, submissions and support cases while you're signed in.

What I can't do: I can't see anyone else's data, change your account settings, approve or process anything, or reveal a coupon code before you've bought it.

question: Are you a human?
answer: I'm the SaveHatke AI Assistant — an automated assistant, not a person. I can help with coupons, your account questions and finding the right page. For anything that needs a decision or a manual review, like a refund, a rejected coupon or a payout issue, I'll point you to the support team.
